information.description:
Arasaka employs some of the best net-lovers of any megacorp in the world (that they’ve poached from other corps), and often gifts them the best gear available. This makes their netrunners extremely dangerous, though they’re most often seen defending the dataforts of Arasaka-protected or owned locations, such as Konpeki Plaza or Arasaka Tower.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Master hackers who put themselves at risk as they jack into cyberspace to download secrets and infiltrate networks.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Netrunner armored skinsuit. Can store Cyberdeck and support Interface Plugs. Can't be bought in two pieces. Always worn on both Head and Body Location. Adds one Hardware only Option Slot to connected Cyberdeck. No armor penalty.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Remember when you could easily browse the Datapool to get info? Yeah, not anymore.

Smart Lens (Micro Chrome, pg. 1) that covers both eyes. While worn, this item acts as a mobile CitiLink connection, providing the wearer a +2 bonus to Library Search Checks. They also count as an instance of Urban Flash Mirrorshades, and come in a variety of colors.
